pages.title: About Us
pages.body:

pages.title: Return & Refund Policy
pages.body:
## Return Policy

At **ORVISH**, we strive to ensure that every customer has a great experience with our products. However, due to the nature of fragrance products, certain return conditions apply.

## Non-Returnable Products

Perfumes and fragrance oils are **non-returnable products** due to hygiene and safety reasons. We do **not offer refunds or exchanges** for fragrances that have been opened or used.

## Damaged or Defective Products

Returns or replacements will only be accepted if the product received is **damaged or defective**. Customers must report such issues within **5 days of receiving the parcel**.

## One-Time Replacement Policy

We offer a **one-time replacement** if you are not satisfied with the fragrance. Conditions:

- Replacement is only available for orders **₹500 or above**.
- Orders with value **below ₹500 are not eligible for replacement**.
- Replacement is allowed **only once per order**.

## Shipping Charges

- Shipping charges are **non-refundable**.
- Any cost incurred by the customer to return the product will **not be reimbursed**.
- The customer will be responsible for the **return shipping cost**.
- Shipping costs are also non-refundable in cases where packages are **undelivered, unclaimed, or refused** by the customer.
- The only exception applies if the error occurred from our side during shipping.

## Return Instructions

If you need to return a product, please follow the instructions below:

- Returns must be requested **within 5 days of receiving the order**. You can raise the request from **My account → Orders**, or contact us on WhatsApp.
- Carefully **pack the product securely** to avoid damage during transit.
- Write the following details clearly on the return parcel: **Order ID**, **Full Name** and **Email Address**.

If the returned product is received **damaged due to improper packaging**, the product may be discarded upon arrival and **no refund or replacement will be issued**.

## Important Notes

Returns will **not be accepted** in cases of:

- Damage caused by **improper use or handling**
- Damage due to **customer negligence**
- Products returned **without proper packaging**

## Refund Policy

At **ORVISH**, refunds are processed in accordance with our store policies and are subject to approval by our customer support team. If you wish to request a refund, please contact our customer support team to verify whether your order is eligible for a return or refund.

## Refund Process

Approved refunds will be processed to the **original payment source** used during checkout. For **Cash on Delivery (COD) orders**, customers will be required to provide their **bank account details** so that the refund can be processed.

## Processing Time

Once a refund request is approved, the refund will be processed within a reasonable time frame. Refunds may take **up to 7 working days** to reflect in your account depending on the payment provider or bank processing time.

## Payment Gateway Charges

All refunds are subject to a **2.5% deduction**, which covers payment gateway processing fees.

## Failed Online Transactions

If an online payment fails but the amount is deducted from your bank account, the refund is **automatically processed back to the original payment source**. Please allow **up to 7 working days** for the amount to reflect in your account.

*Note: ORVISH does not hold this amount. The refund is handled by the payment gateway or banking partner.*

## Need Assistance?

For return or refund queries, please contact our support team:

**Email:** [support@orvish.com](mailto:support@orvish.com)

**Customer Support:** [+91 81569 53937](tel:+918156953937)

pages.title: Shipping Policy
pages.body:
At **ORVISH**, we aim to deliver your order quickly and safely across India. We partner with trusted courier companies to ensure fast and secure delivery of every order.

## Order Processing

Orders are typically processed within **1 working day** after they are placed. Once your order is processed, it is handed over to our courier partner for shipment. We understand that every order can be a special purchase for yourself or a gift for someone you care about, and we take extra care to ensure safe packaging and delivery.

You will receive an email when your order is confirmed and when it is shipped, with the courier tracking details. You can also follow your order any time from **[Track order](/track)**.

## Delivery Time & Shipping Charges

- **Estimated delivery:** 3 – 6 working days across India. Remote areas and the North Eastern Region may take a little longer.
- **Shipping charges:** ₹49 per order, and **free delivery on orders above ₹999**.

Delivery timelines may vary depending on your location, courier operations, or public holidays.

## Cash on Delivery (COD)

Where Cash on Delivery is available, you will see it as a payment option at checkout. Online payments are accepted by UPI, cards and net banking through our secure payment partner.

## Undelivered or Refused Parcels

Shipping charges are non-refundable for packages that are undelivered, unclaimed, or refused by the customer. Please make sure your address and phone number are correct at checkout.

## Need Assistance?

If you have any questions about your delivery, contact us on **WhatsApp** at [+91 81569 53937](https://wa.me/918156953937) or by email at [support@orvish.com](mailto:support@orvish.com).

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.body:
This Privacy Policy explains how **ORVISH** (orvish.com) collects, uses and protects your information.

## Information we collect

- **Order details:** your name, phone number, email address and delivery address (including a map location if you choose one).
- **Account details:** if you sign in with email, Google or phone, we keep your sign-in details so you can see your orders and reuse your saved address.
- **Reviews:** the name, rating and comment you submit.
- **Website activity:** which pages are viewed, products added to cart, the device type, and an approximate location (city or area) worked out from your internet connection. This is used only to understand how the site is used. Your device is recognised by a random ID, not by your name.

## How we use it

- To process, ship and support your order, and to send you important order updates by email.
- To handle returns, refunds and customer support.
- To improve our products, pricing and website.

## Payments

Online payments are processed by our payment partner (Razorpay). Your card, UPI or bank details are entered on their secure page. **We never see or store your card details.**

## Who we share it with

We **do not sell your data**. We share it only with services needed to run the store: our payment partner, courier companies (name, phone and address for delivery), and our hosting, sign-in and email providers.

## Cookies and local storage

We store small pieces of data on your device to keep your cart, remember your saved address and keep you signed in.

## Your choices

You can ask us to correct or delete your personal information at any time by writing to [support@orvish.com](mailto:support@orvish.com) or on WhatsApp at [+91 81569 53937](https://wa.me/918156953937).

## Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version is always on this page.
